newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisian president says media to get more access.
newsitem.headline: Tunisian president says media to get more access.

text.p: Tunisian President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali on Saturday asked his ministers to provide the media with more access to economic data at a time when the country is opening itself to international markets.
"Economic information and data circulation are essential for national economy to meet its challenges..." Ben Ali said in an address to Tunisian businessmen.

"We reiterate the necessity for all, ministers supervising the various domains of activities or other partners, to conform to these principles (of press freedom) and to help this (information) sector accomplish its role in a better way," Ben Ali said.

Ben Ali said journalists' concerns over access to sources of information and of press freedom were discussed during a meeting he held last month with editors of the main privately-owned newspapers in the country. Press sources said the editors complained about the difficulties of access to government data.
